verdict.rationale: Jan is a local LLM runner, so CPU+GPU offload is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence does show it runs local GGUF models via a llama.cpp-powered server, but nothing documents GPU layer offload, a CPU/GPU split, or running models larger than available VRAM. The underlying llama.cpp engine is a building block and cannot be credited as Jan's own documented capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models larger than my available VRAM using combined CPU+GPU offload
